entities.name: Time stream
entities.description: The time continuum of each multiverse, imaginable as a constantly extending line from the multiverse's beginning to the current global time.

entities.name: Time rifts
entities.description: Bridges between alternate time streams that create serious temporal stresses and can collapse a time stream.

entities.name: Phasing
entities.description: A magical means of removing an object from the time stream for a set time, an analogue of travel into the future.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver being built by Urza as a probe to be sent back in time, long the only known traveler backward in time.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Researcher whose failed experiments on Tolaria created fast and slow time bubbles and who built Karn.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker, the second person to travel back through time, who became an orphan of time.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A time manipulator who used the Temporal Anchor to travel back to the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who in the novel Test of Metal explained clockworking.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker who claimed he could perform clockworking magic.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A dragon who fought Bolas in the pivotal fight Sarkhan traveled back to witness.

entities.name: Chianul
entities.description: A Temur shaman who in the old timeline saw a Tarkir dominated by dragons.

entities.name: Arel
entities.description: A Temur shaman who in the new timeline saw a Tarkir where the dragons have fallen and khans rule.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane whose Temur shamans speak of the past, the now and the unwritten now, and whose history Sarkhan altered.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The island where Urza's failed experiments created time bubbles and where Karn's time travel changed the result of the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Ugin's Nexus
entities.description: A nexus on Tarkir that Sarkhan used to travel back in time.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: An artifact whose firing mechanism Teferi traveled back in time to learn.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: A device in Urza's Tower that enhanced Teferi's time manipulation powers.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war to which Teferi traveled back in time.

entities.name: Clockworkers
entities.description: Mages who treat time as a spatial dimension and can jump through it or choose among alternate timelines.

events.summary: Urza's failed experiments on Tolaria produce fast and slow bubbles of time.
events.quote: Failed experiments by Urza on Tolaria resulted in fast and slow bubbles of time.

events.summary: Urza builds the silver Karn as a probe to be sent back in time, since temporal stresses would kill natural bodies.
events.quote: he built Karn whose initial purpose was that of a probe to be sent back in time

events.summary: Karn, now the embodiment of the Legacy, travels hundreds of years back in time without a machine.
events.quote: he succeeded in moving hundreds of years back in time.

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol uses Ugin's Nexus to travel 1,280 years back to the fight between Bolas and Ugin.
events.quote: he traveled 1,280 years back to the pivotal fight between Bolas and Ugin .

events.summary: Teferi uses the Temporal Anchor in Urza's Tower to travel back to the Brothers' War to learn how to fire the Golgothian Sylex.
events.quote: to travel back in time to the Brothers' War .

events.summary: Karn's time travel on Tolaria changes the result of the Phyrexian invasion on that island.
events.quote: changed the result of the Phyrexian invasion on that island

events.summary: Sarkhan's change to Tarkir's history means he is never born, a grandfather paradox; he survives as an orphan of time and is returned to the present.
events.quote: Dubbed since then an orphan of time, he was returned to the time stream's present moment.

events.summary: Tezzeret explains clockworking, and Nicol Bolas claims to be capable of it; the events are later explained as a fevered dream of Tezzeret.
events.quote: have later been explained as a fevered dream of Tezzeret.

relations.quote: he built Karn whose initial purpose was that of a probe to be sent back in time

relations.note: his time travel altered Tarkir's history
relations.quote: Sarkhan's actions altered the history of Tarkir

relations.note: they fought in a pivotal battle
relations.quote: the pivotal fight between Bolas and Ugin .
